summary: This code defines a function that greets someone by name if provided, otherwise greets the world generically. It then calls that function and prints the result to the screen.

explanations.5: The double equals operator checks if the firstname parameter is an empty string.
explanations.8: The dot operator concatenates (joins together) two strings: the literal text 'Hello ' and whatever name was passed in.
explanations.14: The function is being called without any arguments, so $firstname will be undefined, which PHP treats as an empty string in the comparison.
